hero.title: You're more <hl>interesting</hl> than you think
hero.subtitle: Persona builds your portrait from six real assessments — logic, personality, values, attachment, stress and shadows. No horoscopes, no guesswork: only what can actually be measured.

stage.portraitText: You're the kind of person who watches first — and only then trusts…

s1.title: Take six tests
s1.text: Classic instruments — from IQ matrices to the PID-5. At your own pace: progress is saved, so you can come back anytime.

s2.title: Get your portrait
s2.text: The AI reads all six results together and writes one coherent text about you: strengths, blind spots, and patterns you can't see from the inside.

s3.title: Go deeper
s3.text: Compare compatibility with friends, reflect with an AI that knows you, and build a shelf of books and films matched to your character.

tests.title: What the portrait is made of
tests.subtitle: Not "which color are you" — instruments backed by decades of research.

iq.name: Logic

portrait.title: A text you'll recognize yourself in
portrait.subtitle: Not a pile of scores and charts. The AI reads all six results together and writes one connected text — about how it all fits together in you.
portrait.p1: Strengths — and where they work for you
portrait.p2: Blind spots you can't see from the inside
portrait.p3: Patterns in relationships, work, and decisions
portrait.excerpt: You're the kind of person who watches for a long time first — and only then trusts. In an unfamiliar group you don't rush to speak: you read the rules of the game and the balance of power, and you join the conversation once you can see right through it.

match.title: Where you match — and where it sparks
match.subtitle: Invite a friend or partner. Persona compares your results across all six dimensions and tells you honestly what your bond is built on and where the conflicts hide.

chat.title: Reflect with someone who has studied you
chat.subtitle: This chat remembers your results. Ask about yourself — and get an answer about you, not generic advice from the internet.
chat.userMsg: Why is it so hard for me to ask for help?
chat.aiMsg: Look: your attachment test shows high avoidance — it feels safer to cope alone. And here's what your COPE results add to that…

reads.title: Books and films that will actually land
reads.subtitle: Swipe through a queue built from your portrait: not bestseller lists — matches for your character.

page.title: Pricing
page.subtitle: Everything essential in Persona is free. Persona Pro exists for one thing: unlimited conversation with an AI that knows your results.
billing: Prices are in US dollars. Local sales tax or VAT may be added at checkout depending on where you are; the total you will be charged is always shown before you confirm.
Both plans renew automatically — the weekly plan every 7 days, the monthly plan on the same date each month — until you cancel.
The weekly plan starts with a 3-day free trial for first-time subscribers. Cancel before the trial ends and nothing is charged.
Cancel at any time under Profile → Persona Pro, or from the link in your Paddle receipt. Pro stays active until the end of the period you have already paid for.
Payments, invoices and tax are handled by Paddle.com Market Ltd, our authorised reseller and Merchant of Record. Persona never sees your card details.
Persona Pro is bought inside the app: create a free account, and the plan picker with secure Paddle checkout is under Profile → Persona Pro.

final.title: Your portrait is waiting
final.subtitle: Start with the first test — Persona will assemble the rest.

footer.tagline: Six real assessments, an AI portrait, and conversations about you.
